label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter flows directly into the cookie value via doSomething(), then into the HTML response printed by println(). Although ESAPI.encodeForHTML() is called on the variable containing the user input, the resulting encoded string is concatenated into the HTML body without further escaping within the context of the surrounding HTML tags (which appear to be unescaped literals). This allows script injection into the rendered page content. The insecure-cookie rule also flags the missing Secure flag, confirming the cookie is sent over HTTP.

evidence.note: User parameter captured and passed to doSomething()
doSomething preserves user input in bar list and returns it
Encoded user input concatenated into HTML response, allowing XSS
